title: On Many-logic modal structures and information-based logics
summary: This paper proposes an approach to information-based logics using many-logic modal structures (MLMS). These structures can express accessibility relations between worlds with different underlying logics by anchoring them to a base lattice, which contains the semantics of each logic as a down-complete sublattice. MLMS are suitable for representing connections between information states (i.e., configurations of databases) and the evolution of information states over time.
